title: Burns
steps: Cool the burn with running water for at least 10 minutes.
Cover with a clean, non-fluffy cloth or sterile dressing.
Seek medical help if burn is severe.
training: Practice safe handling of hot objects and learn basic burn first aid.

title: Cuts and Bleeding
steps: Clean the wound with clean water.
Seek medical help if bleeding continues.
training: Learn wound cleaning and bandaging techniques in a first aid course.

title: Choking
steps: If unable to breathe, perform 5 back blows between shoulder blades.
Call emergency services if obstruction persists.
training: Practice Heimlich maneuver on training dummies in CPR/first aid sessions.

title: Fractures
steps: Do not try to straighten the bone.
training: Learn splinting and immobilization methods during first aid training.
